report.headline: NSW1 dispatch RRP peaked at 531.84849 $/MWh for the 5-minute interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-31 07:30 AEST).
summary: NSW1 dispatch RRP peaked at 531.84849 $/MWh for the 5-minute interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-31 07:30 AEST) (ev0440).

The Directlink notice 'Inter-regional transfer limit variation - Directlink all 3 cables' gives 2026-07-27 07:00 AEST (2026-07-26T21:00:00Z), before the first 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold: interval ending 2026-07-30 21:10 AEST (2026-07-30T11:10:00Z).
There were 14 five-minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh in the window (ev0876; threshold ev0878).
Operational demand in the half-hour ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z was 11178.0 MW (ev0903); the window maximum operational demand was 11382.0 MW (ev0880).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND (5-minute) at the 5-minute peak interval was 11432.7 MW (ev0441) and NETINTERCHANGE at that interval was -1144.98 MW (reported as net flow into NSW1) (ev0442).

AEMO published a market notice reporting a planned outage of Directlink all 3 cables scheduled from 0700 hrs 27/07/2026 to 1700 hrs 31/07/2026 and returned to service at 1430 hrs 31/07/2026 (market_notice_144695#0).

Large unit SCADA changes are recorded in the window (examples: ERARING +397.78 MW ev0936; MP -399.79 MW ev0933; ERBESS -435.02 MW ev0930) but these SCADA readings alone do not by themselves identify causes.

possible_explanations.statement: The planned outage of Directlink all 3 cables reported in the market notice [market_notice_144695#0] might have reduced NSW1's interconnector capability and could have altered dispatch outcomes around 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check per-interconnector declared available transfer capability and flow records for the interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (2026-07-30T21:30:00Z) and the dispatch constraint binding list for that same interval to see whether Directlink-related constraints were invoked and binding.

possible_explanations.statement: Local supply/demand shifts or large generator dispatch changes might have contributed to high prices (examples of large SCADA changes in the window are ERARING +397.78 MW [ev0936], MP -399.79 MW [ev0933], ERBESS -435.02 MW [ev0930]), which could have affected dispatch and prices independently of interconnector availability.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine unit rebid logs and offer/availability changes for major generators in the hour before 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z and check constraint binding reports for the interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z to see which units or constraints were binding.

possible_explanations.statement: Ramping of planned outage constraint sets (per AEMO procedures) might have altered the dispatch solution during the outage period and could be relevant to the price behaviour; the dispatch procedure describes a ramping process for planned outage constraints [aemo_so_op_3705#p40c132].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain the outage-related constraint set activity and pre-dispatch ramp schedules for the Directlink outage and check whether ramped constraint equations were active or binding at interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z.

citations.quote: A planned outage of Directlink all 3 cables in the NSW region was scheduled from 0700 hrs 27/07/2026 to 1700 hrs 31/07/2026.
citations.supports: Shows the scheduled planned outage window for Directlink covering the event date.

citations.quote: (a) The Network Constraint Ramping Tool (part of the SOMMS application) allows the creation of ramping constraints for any planned outage constraint irrespective of whether the LHS of the constraint includes interconnectors and/or generators.
citations.supports: Describes that planned outage constraints may be ramped in pre-dispatch/dispatch and therefore could affect dispatch pricing behaviour during outages.

uncertainties: Whether a Directlink-related outage constraint set was invoked and binding at the interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z is not known from the retrieved evidence.
Per-interconnector declared available transfer capability for Directlink and per-interconnector flow time-series for the peak interval were not retrieved here.

Rebid logs and the MMS dispatch binding-constraint list for the interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z were not retrieved; without them we cannot identify which constraints or bid changes determined the dispatch outcome.

Dispatch MMS binding-constraint list and outage constraint set activity for the interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z (to confirm whether Directlink-related constraints were invoked/binding).
Rebid logs and unit offer/availability changes for major generators in the hour before 2026-07-30T21:30:00Z.
A dispatch re-run or counterfactual dispatch (Directlink available) to quantify the counterfactual price impact.
